# What LarkAgentX imports at run time, installed on first start with pip --require-hashes: every package, the transitive
# ones too, is pinned with the SHA-256 of each of its files on PyPI, so the code that runs is fixed by this file.
# LarkAgentX's own pins, except: requests (CVE-2024-35195, CVE-2024-47081) and urllib3 at fixed releases, protobuf at
# the last 5.29 (its generated code is 5.29), SQLAlchemy at 2.0.36 (2.0.30 fails on import on Python 3.13; only the
# import needs it). Its CLI's qrcode and questionary are left out. Python 3.9 gets the last releases that support it.
# After changing a pin, take the hashes of all its files from PyPI (pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json).
